summary.name: Luma
summary.one_liner: Luma is a creative AI agent and model platform from Luma Labs that plans, generates, iterates and refines video and other creative assets, with the Dream Machine video generator as its earlier known product.
use_cases: generate video clips from text prompts
send creative output into Figma or Frame.io
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Luma as a creative agent that helps plan, generate, iterate and refine creative work while keeping context across stages. It says Luma Agent can advance multiple creative directions at once while preserving brand, context and specs, and can resize and localize assets through final delivery. The page names Ray 3.2 as its frontier video model, offering frame-by-frame control and continuity, and Uni as a model that follows complex instructions and maintains brand references. It lists integrations with Figma, Frame.io and Google Ads Console. Individual and Business pricing tiers are shown, but the page text does not give the actual prices.
notable: Luma Agent runs multiple creative directions in parallel while keeping brand and specs
Ray 3.2 frontier video model with frame-by-frame control
Integrations with Figma, Frame.io and Google Ads Console
Enterprise features: admin controls, budget settings, forward-deployed creatives
caveats: Pricing tiers (Individual, Business) are listed but amounts are not given on the page text
Enterprise features are aimed at business teams rather than individual users
